reply_text: Dana, I replied to your DM with the Dock 38 note, but I can't store it persistently, so I sent a correction too. My first message said I had "noted" it, which overstated what I did. Dock 38 is in this DM only and I won't share it elsewhere. If you want it kept for future sessions, put it in your own notes or tell me where to record it.
